description: This file defines internal CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) classes and functions for the Abseil C++ library, including CRC implementation classes, constants, and utility functions related to CRC calculations.

classes.name: CRCImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing CRC functionality, providing interface for CRC calculations and table initialization.

classes.name: CRC32
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CRC for 32-bit CRC calculations, supporting extend, scramble, and zero-extension operations.

methods.name: NewInternal
methods.description: Creates a new internal CRC implementation instance.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Resets or initializes the CRC value.

methods.name: FillWordTable
methods.description: Fills a table for CRC update by one word of specified size.

methods.name: FillZeroesTable
methods.description: Builds a table for extending CRC with zero bytes.

methods.name: Extend
methods.description: Extends the CRC with additional bytes.

methods.name: ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends the CRC with zero bytes.

methods.name: Scramble
methods.description: Scrambles the CRC value for non-linearity.

methods.name: Unscramble
methods.description: Reverses the scrambling of the CRC value.
